entries.title: Unverified: TCL 55EP640 remote
entries.evidence: UNVERIFIED candidate for Fujicom. No Fujicom remote capture, code table, remote model number or chassis/ODM was found (Fujicom Israel product pages, Flipper-IRDB, IRDB, SmartIR, Linux keymaps and web searches; universal-remote code lists only give vendor setup numbers). Fujicom sells budget Android TVs (e.g. FJ-65F with Android 9, FJ-43ZX650 with Android 11) on unnamed Chinese boards, so this Android-TV remote of another brand is offered for the code wizard to try. Not tested on a Fujicom TV.
